qs: Rule 1: From top to bottom the dial turns 45° clockwise and continues on to the next column.
Rule 2: There is a circle of each shade in every column and row.
Rule 1: The shaded rectangle shifts one place to the left from row to row.
Rule 2: The 1st column has a horizontal line through the middle, the 2nd has a vertical line on the left and the 3rd column has a vertical line on the right.
Rule 1: From the left across each row, the first two shapes combine to create the third shape.
Rule 2: From the top of each column, the first two shapes combine to create the third shape.
Rule 1: From top to bottom, the shaded segment moves one place to the right and continues onto the next column.
Rule 2: From left to right, the shaded circle moves one place clockwise and continues onto the next row.
Rule 1: From left to right, the down and right mark shift to their right, while the two up marks stay in position.
Rule 1: From top to bottom, the line moves from left to right and continues onto the next column.
Rule 2: From left to right, the line alternates between being vertical, diagonal or horizontal and continues onto the next row.
Rule 1: From top to bottom, the number of squares increases by one until there are three and starts again on a new column.
Rule 2: From left to right, the squares rotate by 45° each time.
Rule 3: From left to right, the shading alternates across each individual square within each box. So across all the boxes there should be a black-white-black-white pattern.
Rule 1: From left to right, the triangle rotates 45° each time and continues onto the next row.
Rule 2: From top to bottom, the shaded star moves one place clockwise and continues onto the next column.
Rule 1: From left to right, the number of squares increases by two each time and continues onto the next row.
Rule 2: From left to right, the unshaded square moves one place to the right each time and continues onto the next row.
Rule 1: Each column contains a consistent number of horizontal lines.
Rule 2: From top to bottom, the number of vertical lines double.
Rule 1: From left to right, the unshaded rectangle moves one place to the right and continues onto the next row.
Rule 2: From top to bottom, the small rectangle moves two places to the right and continues onto the next column.
Rule 1: From left to right, the unshaded circle moves one place to the right each time.
Rule 2: From top to bottom, the number of circles decreases by one.
Rule 1: From left to right, each shape moves two places to the right. This continues onto the next row
Rule 2: From left to right, the ‘filled shape’ moves one place to the right. This continues onto the next row (looping around to the first shape).
Rule 1: From left to right, the shape rotates 135° counter-clockwise.
Rule 2: From left to right, the highlighted prong moves one space clockwise.
Rule 1: Each box must contain a total of ten edges.
Rule 2: From left to right, final shape becomes the first shape of the next box.
Rule 1: From left to right, the ‘crossed’ box moves one place anticlockwise. This continues onto the next row
Rule 2: From left to right, the total number of filled shapes increases by one until there are five and then resets. The pattern continues onto the next row.
Rule 1: The four corners composite into the middle shape.
Rule 2: The four sides composite into the middle shape.
Rule 1: From left to right, the matrix rotates 45°

Rule 2: From left to right, the total number of shaded circles per box decreases by one and remains in the same place. The pattern that is left retains some symmetry. (Alternatively, the number of unshaded circles increases by one).
Rule 1: From left to right, the second symbol becomes the first symbol of the next box. This continues on to the next line.
Rule 2: From top to bottom, the first symbol becomes the second symbol of the next box. The bottom box of each column carried on to the next column.
Rule 1: From left to right, the cross on the left symbol moves in the sequence: up, down, left, right and repeats. Alternatively, the symbols on the NW-SE diagonal are identical
Rule 2: From top to bottom, the right hand symbol rotates 45° anticlockwise.
Rule 1: From top to bottom, the notches move clockwise to the next corner. Alternatively, from left to right, the notches move to the next corner anticlockwise. This continues onto the next row.
Rule 2: From left to right, the total number of notches in each box increases by one. This continues onto the next row.
Rule 1: In columns, the middle arrow is the same at the top row as the bottom row.
Rule 2: The left and right arrows will copy each other in position.
Rule 1: Each column and row has one box with a single line symbol, one box with a double line symbol, and one box with a triple line symbol.
Rule 2: Each column and row has two lines that are bold.
Rule 1: From left to right, the rightmost and leftmost arrow rotates 90° clockwise.
Rule 2: Each row and column, has one box with both central arrows facing up, one box with both central arrows facing down, and one box with the central arrows facing opposite directions.
Rule 1: From left to right, the black square moves three spaces counterclockwise, this continues onto the next row.

Rule 2: From left to right, the number increases by 1 inverts horizontally and is placed opposite to the black square. Alternatively, the number increases by 1, mirrors horizontally and then moves anticlockwise three places around the perimeter of the square.
Rule 1: From left to right, the symbol rotates 90° clockwise, this continues onto the next row.
Rule 2: From left to right, the colours alternate, this continues onto the next row.
Rule 1: From left to right, the shaded pentagon moves one place clockwise, this continues onto the next row.
Rule 2: From left to right, the line in the central pentagon rotates 72° counterclockwise (i.e. begins at the next point of the pentagon), this continues onto the next row.
Rule 1: From top to bottom, the shaded box moves one place counterclockwise, this continues onto the next row.
Rule 2: From left to right, the arrow points to the corner where the next arrow will appear, this continues onto the next row.
Rule 1: Starting from the bottom right, from bottom to top, the shapes change by vertical and horizontal reflection in alternation.
Rule 1: From left to right, the arrow rotates 90° counterclockwise, this continues onto the next row.
Rule 2: From left to right, the symbol on the bottom right of the box indicates whether to add or remove a notch to/from the next arrow. This continues onto the next row.
Rule 1: From left to right, the arrow rotates 90˚ counter clockwise. This pattern continues onto the next row.

Rule 2: From left to right, the black box moves 3 places clockwise (the places being: top left, top, middle, top right, middle right, bottom right, bottom middle, bottom left and left middle) This pattern continues onto the next row. Alternatively from top to bottom, the black square moves one place clockwise each time.
Rule 1: From left to right, the colour of the squares alternates from blue to white. This pattern continues onto the next row.
Rule 2: The number of squares in each box is equal to the total number of squares in the two previous boxes. This pattern continues onto the next row.
Rule 1: From left to right, the symbol rotates 45˚ counterclockwise. This pattern continues onto the next row.
Rule 2: Each row and each column must have a total of six blue squares and 6 white squares.
Rule 1: Each row and column, the arrow alternates from up to down and vice-versa.
Rule 2: From left to right, each column increases by one more arrow.
Rule 1: From top to bottom, the number of notches in the bottom left corner increases by 1. This pattern continues onto the next column.
Rule 2: In each box, the number of lines in each shape corresponds to the number of notches.
Rule 1: From left to right, the arrow moves two places clockwise. This pattern continues onto the next row.
Rule 2: From top to bottom, the highlighted area on the pentagon moves one place counterclockwise. This pattern continues onto the next line.
